name: Lipschitz Constant Estimation
definition: Estimates the Lipschitz constant for the implicit function by sampling gradient norms over the bounding box. This constant is used by the interval inclusion function to prune intervals.
summary: Lipschitz Constant Estimation computes a scalar bound limiting the maximum rate of change of an implicit scalar field, differing from sibling methods by providing the global or local bound itself rather than using a gradient for a specific linear step.
